searchText: Hi, I am trying to build a C# implementation of a beacon chain light client. I came across the constants `FINALIZED_ROOT_INDEX `and `NEXT_SYNC_COMMITTEE_INDEX`, that are calculated using the `get_generalized_index` function. The value of these constants is pre-computed in Lodestar's implementation of the light client. Am I supposed to reuse these values for my implementation or should I get them from the `get_generalized_index` function? Hi Mihir. What I’ve realized is that most of the verbiage used within Lodestar[Typescript] will correlate heavily within the chosen language you’re using to build. For example, the `Vector<>` function within Lodestar’s light-client was essentially `SszVector<>` within the Teku[Java] client I’m using to build my Java version of the light-client, so I just imported that function into my light-client build. Hope this helps. In fact, Lodestar already had a “semi light-client” built within the Altair fork (that you can all refer to) here: https://github.com/ChainSafe/lodestar/blob/master/packages/types/src/altair/types.ts And here: https://github.com/ChainSafe/lodestar/blob/master/packages/types/src/altair/sszTypes.ts Thanks Jeremy, I will look into the links you shared. 🙂
